instruction: Open https://www.canadapost-postescanada.ca/cpc/en/tools/find-a-rate.page. Get Canada Post rates for a package weighing 3.2 kg that is 40 cm long, 30 cm wide and 20 cm high, sent from postal code M5S 2H7 to postal code V6B 1A1 in Canada.
